description: Land Title Settlement Department - Sooriyapaluwa, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510810 (23/0057)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, identity card numbers, addresses, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property registration, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements for specific land parcels in designated locations.
